title: shorea selanica
intro: Shorea selanica, commonly known as Selan Tree or Selanwood, is a species of tree in the family Dipterocarpaceae, native to Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various health conditions due to its rich content of bioactive compounds. The health benefits of Shorea selanica include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which can aid in the treatment of wounds, infections, and other diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-cancer, and cardiovascular protective effects.
